name: Trooper Dalrymple
blurb: A state trooper in mirrored shades. Quick off the mark, and fond of the taser.

look.description: A state trooper in grey with a campaign hat that has never once blown off, until today.

meta.notes: M4 cops-3 head start: a second Keys cop for the spawn mix, from the state-trooper side of the law (the tone guide's 'state troopers on the highway'). A made-up name and agency. His id sorts after sgt-pruitt, so an event that fields one cop still fields Pruitt. Crude starting numbers, [default]. Run W-T (law with a personality): he finally rides (live). His habit is `radar`: on patrol he waits at the route's first long bridge (300 m or more over water) with a radar beside him, reads each player once as he comes within about 160 m, and lights up only for one over 29 m/s (about 65 mph); one under the limit rides by. Clocked, the player takes 20 heat. In a Keys race he is the second cop fielded, so the patrol usually sends him. [default]
